# Acorn 8.15.0

`acorn.cjs` is the standalone Acorn parser bundled with the installed Node.js runtime, copied without source changes (apart from line-ending/final-newline normalization).

Upstream: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/tree/8.15.0/acorn

License: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/blob/8.15.0/acorn/LICENSE

Authors: https://github.com/acornjs/acorn/blob/8.15.0/acorn/AUTHORS

The MIT license is included alongside the parser. Workshop uses this offline parser only to inspect syntax, never to execute proposed JavaScript. Production does not use Node private APIs to obtain the parser.
